methodology_note: Each whitespace follows: (1) client's own public statement or dated internal CXO record naming an investment priority, (2) check of Capgemini's internal deal/CXO position on that exact theme, (3) check for named competitor activity in that specific space, (4) verdict, (5) matching offer or asset pulled verbatim from the A&D Offers & Assets master, or 'none in current portfolio'. No scoring. No commentary on account relationship health or deal conversion quality.

whitespaces.theme: Production quality / traveled-work reduction

Boeing ramping 737 from 42 to 47/month, targeting 52 then 57.
whitespaces.capgemini_position: 3 deals, EUR387M total, EUR1.3M won, EUR0 active pipeline, EUR186M lost, EUR199.7M dropped.
whitespaces.competitor_position: No named SI (Accenture/IBM/TCS) confirmed on this specific Boeing program. Boeing appears to be building in-house: internally developed OCR/computer-vision part-verification tool, GenAI Academy (8,000 employees trained, 2,600 certified super users), 70+ generative AI applications built internally as of late 2025.
whitespaces.matching_asset: Computer Vision (ERD, Developed, implemented at Collins France, AWS partnership) - same technical territory as Boeing's in-house tool
whitespaces.notes: Whitespace is real but the entry barrier is different: this looks like an insourcing preference, not an open competitive gap. No current Boeing relationship to attach the asset to.

whitespaces.theme: GTF engine fleet inspection and shop-visit surge
whitespaces.client_evidence: The Pratt & Whitney GTF powder-metal manufacturing defect requires 600-700 incremental shop visits through 2026, a $6-7B financial impact, and repetitive inspection protocols on affected turbine/compressor disks. Also affects Airbus A220 and Embraer E2 variants (PW1500G/PW1900G).
whitespaces.capgemini_position: Combined RTX family (RTX parent EUR12.7M pipeline, Pratt & Whitney EUR0.228M lost, Collins Aerospace EUR0.484M) totals roughly EUR13.4M against an issue with a $6-7B fleet-wide impact.
whitespaces.competitor_position: General MRO-AI competitor activity from TCS applies (see AD-01); no P&W-specific competitor confirmed.
whitespaces.matching_asset: Computer Vision (ERD, Developed, detects defects as small as 0.2mm sq, implemented at Collins France) - directly relevant to turbine/compressor disk defect inspection; Intelligent Repair Assistant also applicable
whitespaces.notes: Scale mismatch between the issue's financial magnitude and Capgemini's current RTX-family footprint is the whole story here.

cross_cutting_observations: The insourcing pattern is the single biggest theme across this dataset, not an isolated case: Boeing (AD-04), Dassault (AD-08), L3Harris (AD-09), Embraer (AD-13), Huntington Ingalls (AD-18), and DGAC (AD-21) all show primes/institutions building digital and production tooling in-house or via boutique partners rather than through traditional SIs. For roughly a third of the confirmed whitespaces, the real entry challenge is 'make the case against insourcing,' not 'displace a named competitor.'

Airbus (AD-05), Naval Group (AD-12), Safran (AD-23), and BAE Systems (AD-24) are documented non-whitespaces to show the external-signal-first method rules candidates out as often as it confirms them - all four already carry active won or pipeline value matching the external signal found.

CNES (AD-20) surfaced a live discrepancy between the workbook (no data) and independently reported reality (an active Capgemini-CNES collaboration exists). This should be treated as a data-quality flag for the wider roster, not just a one-off - the workbook may be similarly incomplete for other institutional accounts.

Capgemini is independently named a Leader in all four quadrants of the 2026 ISG Provider Lens for U.S. Aerospace & Defense Services and Solutions - worth knowing before assuming a defensive posture across the board.

The RTX/Pratt & Whitney GTF fleet issue (AD-11) and the general MRO whitespace (AD-01) are related but distinct - AD-11 is a specific, dated, quantified event ($6-7B impact, 600-700 shop visits) while AD-01 is a broader industry trend. Keep them as separate entries in the UI rather than merging.
